thread:
maria-sales: Heads-up: acme POC started seeing a flood of 5xxs during a load test this morning. Mostly 503/504 and a few 500s. Sample request_id e4d1b9a2-9f01-4bf3

kyle-support: Which deployment and region? model & approximate QPS?

maria-sales: Hosted (us-west-2), model=redwood-13B-v1. Baseline ~120 rps, spike to ~420 rps for ~90s. Error rate ~12% at peak. request_ids e4d1b9a2-9f01-4bf3, e4d1b9a2-9f01-4bf4

raj-eng: Can you paste the autoscale config they used and whether client-side retries/backoff are enabled? If they’re blasting without backoff it can make things worse. Expected example config:
```
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 4
scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
target_cpu: 70
```

maria-sales: They said default POC autoscale: min=1, max=3. No client retries — using a load test tool. I'll ask them to add exponential backoff but we should patch infra too.

olivia-sre: Infra logs: frontend request queue length hit ~540 queued. Per-host concurrency limit=64. We have a cutoff where queue > 500 triggers 503s to protect latencies. Autoscaler events occurred but new replica model load timed out (GPU warmup + model load ~45-60s).

deploy-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale from 2 -> 3 at 2026-01-29T15:02:12Z; status=started
deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale completed at 2026-01-29T15:03:18Z; new_replica_ready=false; model_load_timeout

raj-eng: Root cause: autoscale lag + low max_replicas = transient overload. Quick mitigations:
- bump min_replicas for POC or enable burst pool
- enable overflow routing to a smaller compatible model (redwood-7B) as fallback

kyle-support: Can we toggle overflow routing for this account right now? Also what's a safe min_replicas for POCs that hit ~400 rps?

olivia-sre: For sustained 400 rps on 13B with default batching you'd want min_replicas=3-4. Immediate fix: enable overflow to redwood-7B (same tokenizer) to reduce latency and avoid 503s.

raj-eng: Also require client-side retry with jittered exponential backoff: start=50ms, max=2s, attempts=4. Add header so edge can do variant failover: `x-fallback-allowed: true`.

maria-sales: Customer is nervous — can support enable overflow + temporarily bump min_replicas to 3? I'll ask them to add client retry.

kyle-support: Doing it now — flipping overflow flag and bumping min_replicas for their project.

deploy-bot: account-config: set overflow_model=redwood-7B for acct:acme-inc by kyle-support
deploy-bot: infra: updated cluster desired_min_replicas=3 for project:acme-poc

olivia-sre: Post-change metrics: queued requests down to <120, 5xx rate fell to ~0.9% within ~90s. Still seeing occasional 504s for long generations (>12s) — recommend host-side request timeout + retry on client.

maria-sales: Great — customer confirmed demo resumed. Can we document POC best-practices for sales to preconfigure? Also they want an estimate of pricing impact from bumping min_replicas.

raj-eng: I'll draft a POC runbook snippet: recommend min_replicas=2-3 for medium spikes, enable overflow to smaller model, and require client retry policy. On pricing: min_replicas increases baseline hourly cost; I'll send a quick per-hour estimate.

kyle-support: Action items:
- raj-eng: write POC runbook snippet + cost calc (ETA 2h)
- kyle-support: enable overflow + bump min_replicas (done)
- maria-sales: ask customer to add client retries & confirm load profile (in progress)

maria-sales: :thumbsup:

olivia-sre: Follow-up: propose a transient burst pool feature (fast-warm instances or kept-warm pool) to prevent cold model load spikes for POCs. I'll file an RFC.

maria-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and close the loop.
